node.title: Re: Using negative lookahead
node.author: haukex
node.doctext: The others have already given you some excellent answers. I just wanted to point out [mod://Regexp::Common::delimited] as well as [doc://Text::Balanced], which contain functions that implement something like what you are doing. Also, this task sounds like something that one encounters when parsing formats for which parsers might already exist, a common one being [mod://Text::CSV]. Also, personally I find it easier to write my regex tests as I showed in [id://1201201].
